path.id: A small manufacturer tracks its financial data by graphing its total cost and total revenue. The graph in theÂ xy-plane shows the revenue function,Â y=R(x)y=R(x), and the cost function,Â y=C(x)y=C(x), whereÂ xxÂ represents the number of units produced andÂ yyÂ represents the amount in thousands of dollars. A break-even point is a pointÂ (x,y)(x,y)Â where the total revenue is equal to the total cost.
